_comment: Ticket 26/09/02/SEPARATE-ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSET-IMPLEMENTATIONS-AND-FIXTURE-TEST-EVERY-MUTATION: split out of the former `✳️any` catch-all. buildingSMART BCF-XML 2.1 stores each topic's screen-capture image as its own `snapshot.png` file inside the topic folder, sibling to but distinct from `markup.bcf` and `viewpoint.bcfv`. `set-viewpoint-snapshot` is that file's own mutation, owned here rather than by `🖊️markup`, for the same family-module reuse rationale as `../../👁️viewpoint/🔮️oracle/🔣️.json`.

provenance.attribution: before is an unmodified copy of this subset's own real-world shared fixture 🏥️wellness-center-coordination-review.bcf; after replaces exactly one zip entry (topic 3b1f6a1e…f11's viewpoint 3b1f6a1e…f14.png) with the real PNG bytes this subset's own mutate-bcf-2-1-snapshot differential feature already applies via SetViewpointSnapshot{topicGuid,guid,snapshot} — same document, same parameters, same real evidence, packaged as a v2 fixture pair instead of only a Gherkin-level reference.

fixtureManifests.notes: The only byte-different zip entry between before and after is the target viewpoint's snapshot PNG; every other topic/markup/bcfv entry is byte-identical, matching what SetViewpointSnapshot alone should change.
